column1: # derivation: §7.6: LIKE matches the whole string; `%` is any run of
# zero or more characters, `_` exactly one code point; case-sensitive and
# byte-exact; a NULL subject gives NULL (rows 6 and 8, every column).
# 'h_llo': only row 2, h, U+00E9 (one code point), l, l, o. 'a_b': only
# row 4, U+1F600 one code point between a and b; "abc" has c, not b, third.
# '%': every non-NULL s, '' included (zero characters). '__': exactly two
# ends in b, only row 4. 'ABC': "abc" differs in case, so no row. '_':
# one code point, only row 9 (U+1F600, 4 bytes).
# Types: BOOLEAN, nullable (§8.8); id as scanned.
